list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (names, descriptions and grades), November 2026

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. Single-player only — no multiplayer or DLC is needed. The last one most players earn is A Long Road (100% completion). PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you complete Chapter 1 — right after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you complete Chapter 2 — right after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you complete Chapter 3 — after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you complete Chapter 4 — after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the final mission of the game, in Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and usually the last one earned. Finish the 100% Completion Checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, unlocked after the story). It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests and collectibles are not fully required, and you only need 70 of 80 Challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. Key counts: scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, any 100 Optional Missions.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (the 100% checklist needs 300). Four types: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps — mix them freely; Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track by region at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Performing a stunt once counts as completed; the extra challenges on map icons are not required.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt. Check progress at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most are introduced by the story or marked when you unfog the map (filter Activities, blue dumbbell icon). You will do one of each naturally while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide to all 12 locations and all 42 gold medals.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — All 12 Shooting Range Locations & 42 Gold Medals

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx has a guide to all 14 locations.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — All 14 Top Fun Drone Race Locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists all 40 unique race locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline to unlock it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game ('Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home (use the controllers) from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. 'Complete' means finishing all levels once — you do not need every challenge. Pick whichever you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline (Lucia only). It is marked automatically in Chapter 3; while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls, then appears as a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving at shipwrecks — find underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. 7 shipwrecks in total. Track at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to speed it up).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others do NOT count. Confirmed counting: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races), Pilot Pete (deliveries). Track via the trophy tracker in the trophy list. All available after the story. PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being discovered.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered; track them at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City). Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check the wishlist, then drive one back to his garage (good condition pays more). Sports cars are common around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline (Jason only). It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked purple in Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives the second quest Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which unlocks the trophy. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. You can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, counting +2 per location. Track at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation at Jason's house is only available during Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning, walks to the balcony; follow her and choose 'Accept'. It adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy (PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped). The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so it does not matter there. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2 Coffee Break).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only). It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — Bret texts Jason, first quest Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County. Follow his hunting quests; the first gives the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (retrievable at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track at Map > Activities > Target Deck (15 total; all 15 needed for 100%). PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks this trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PowerPyx has a guide to all 18 card set locations.
trophies.source: PowerPyx — All 18 Collectible Card Set Locations

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations (hold Up + R1 on objects in the world). There are far more than 100; any 100 count. Breakdown: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this pops automatically along the way — there are 10 more than needed, so pick the easiest. Track at Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies; save it for near-last, then pick the quickest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Available after Chapter 2 Coffee Break (free-roam together); call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Get to 4 stars (cause carnage), then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; shoot down any helicopter. Easiest: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) — cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you leave the red 'heat' zone, not just the search area. You will also get it automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Only after Chapter 2 Coffee Break. Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while chased, keeping the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level). Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing; call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop — if it does not pop, hit a 4th. Good spot: the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); rob a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. You need 200 base models for the 100% checklist, so this pops automatically. Track at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate with L3 + R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home; Adrenaline extends it — hold L1, press Triangle). Line up 5 enemies (criminals at Gang Operations work well), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it rises from Shooting Ranges, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots — you will likely hit level 4 naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal — it must be connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. Easiest: the plane at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield, go straight to the plane; stairs by the boarding bridge lead directly inside. Go upstairs to the cockpit, drive backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away — the pop is delayed until you are that far. You can also enter on foot through the terminal.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick for alarmed doors) and marks Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons) on the unfogged map. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (it is permanently in your inventory; at a locked door choose the Snap Gun prompt instead of kicking it). Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it is the intro to bank vault robberies (the first one is automatic in the mission): tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase in and the vault to open, then go in and rob it. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). Afterward, pay Yasmani (fence from Chapter 3) $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier quests, robbing 2 Payday Loans); he marks vans purple — follow one to a bank. Robbing a vault means an instant 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognized. 8 Large Bank Jobs exist; you need 5 here, all 8 for 100%. Up to $205,000 per bank — the best endgame money.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck (you tail the truck to the bank, the guard carries cash to the vault, you enter and steal, then escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You need all 8 Large Bank Jobs for 100%, so it comes automatically. Earlier method: find armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it — it only pops after you escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. Fastest with a plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; you need 1 per gang here, all 39 for the 100% checklist. They are marked yellow on the map when you get near, and many are auto-marked from story progress. Track at Progress > Gangs (scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed).
trophies.source: PowerPyx — All Illegal Gang Operation Locations

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No public guide yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (as of 18 Nov 2026) — the description (a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach) is all that is confirmed. Check back: this guide will be updated here once a source pins it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the specific blue 'Banshee' from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window — only this car counts, not any other. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs). The pop is slightly delayed; it triggers after you drive away on the street. It is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a Gang Operation in Port Gellhorn: the Luxury watch (south-east office, golden icon), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' (table in the north-east corner, golden icon), and the safe loot (north-east hallway office — blow the safe with Sticky Bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation). It pops after you escape the police, not on the third pickup, and killing enemies is not required. It comes up during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling (auto-marked). If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while — go back for the rest; it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Get maximum Strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, heart icon). Only after Chapter 2 Coffee Break (character switching). Raise Strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership and always go together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one trains, the other finishes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many around Vice City, and you can work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices (for better or worse) — actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and a demon face appears at the right of the screen whenever your reputation shifts. Profiles run Professional (stealth, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitate, don't kill), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones), Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence). It comes passively from robberies and encounters while chasing other trophies; if it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but note cops shoot on sight more at Psycho/Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No public guide yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (as of 18 Nov 2026), believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — but that is unconfirmed, so do not grind it yet. Check back once a source pins it down.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No public guide yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (as of 18 Nov 2026), believed to be from a UFO questline — but that is unconfirmed. Check back once a source pins it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No public guide yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (as of 18 Nov 2026), believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — but that is unconfirmed. Check back once a source pins it down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3 Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not all at once. It comes naturally from the robberies for the 100% checklist; a single Bank Vault can pay up to $205,000 (unlocked after Chapter 4 That's Where The Money Is…).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest (the most expensive). Shop counts: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear, 18 Hair & Beauty, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story ones — only the 8 count), costing $160,000 total. They unlock for purchase after Chapter 2 Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone; buy through the app. Fastest money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after Chapter 2 Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered anywhere. You need garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage click 'Respray' then 'Register'. Moses unlocks from the same mission. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
